articles.title: Phonak Launches Roger On Sphere AI Remote Microphone (UK Coverage)
articles.summary: Clarity News reports Phonak has launched Roger On Sphere, a remote microphone using a deep neural network to separate speech from noise in real time, adapting to meetings, restaurants, family gatherings and car journeys. Phonak claims +3 dB SNR benefit (~50% less noise power). Streams directly to Phonak hearing aids and Advanced Bionics cochlear implants without extra hardware; other brands need receivers. No price/availability date stated. Product previously showcased at EUHA (Oct 14).

articles.title: Updated International Guidelines for Audiological Management of Adults with Severe and Profound Hearing Loss
articles.summary: Published online Oct 26, 2026 in Seminars in Hearing (2026;47:175-276; doi 10.1055/s-0046-1827039) by 18 international contributors (Turton, Timmer, Hockley et al.), updating 2020 guidance with evidence through Q1 2026. Scope: adults 19+ with better-ear severe (61-80 dB HL) or profound (81+ dB HL) SNHL. Key points: discuss cochlear implantation as part of comprehensive treatment planning rather than waiting until amplification is no longer useful; expanded CI candidacy, bimodal (CI + contralateral HA) guidance; ASSR preferred over ABR alone when behavioral thresholds unreliable; WDRC, output limiting, custom earmolds, probe-mic verification; frequency lowering off by default; Auracast, remote mics, remote fitting; gene therapies framed as evolving research. No specific CI referral cutoffs reported; no industry funding mentioned in coverage.

articles.title: GN Store Nord Rises 2.77% to DKK 114.95
articles.summary: GN Store Nord shares closed up 2.77% at DKK 114.95 on Oct 27, 2026 (prev close DKK 111.85), its second strong gain in three sessions after +3.37% on Oct 23. US ADR GNNDY +2.5% to $51.50; Zacks upgraded from Strong Sell to Hold (MarketBeat). Same day Rothschild Redburn initiated Amplifon (GN Hearing acquirer) at Buy.

articles.title: Rothschild & Co Redburn Initiates Amplifon at Buy, PT EUR 21; Sees GN Hearing Deal Lifting Margins
articles.summary: Rothschild & Co Redburn initiated coverage of Amplifon with Buy and EUR 21 target (~61% upside vs Oct 27 close EUR 12.98, +1.25%). Analysts project pro forma adjusted EBITDA margin of 27.9% by FY2030 vs 25.7% standalone and pro forma EPS CAGR 19.2% vs 13.7%, driven by internalizing GN supply and stronger US presence. Amplifon -9% YTD vs Sonova +37% and Demant +70%. EGM on Oct 29 votes on 56M-share capital increase reserved for GN Store Nord. GN shares rose 2.77% to DKK 114.95 on Oct 27.

articles.title: Cearvol Launches Liberte Open-Ear OTC Hearing Aid with Real-Time AI Speech Isolation in U.S.
articles.summary: Cearvol announced the U.S. launch of Liberte, an open-ear OTC hearing aid with a four-microphone array and real-time AI speech isolation, following its win in the Non-Traditional Hearing Devices category at the 7th Hearing Technology Innovator Awards. MSRP $399; introductory Amazon coupon to $297. Available nationwide via Amazon and Cearvol store (press release; performance claims are company marketing).

articles.title: Meta on Hearing Enhancement: 'Glasses Is the Ideal Form Factor' — Phone Test Matched Professional Fitting, FSA/HSA Eligible
articles.summary: TechRadar interview with Meta on its FDA-cleared Hearing Enhancement: a 1-2 minute in-app hearing test builds the profile; Meta says its study in mild-to-moderate users found the phone-based test equivalent to professional fitting within an acceptable margin. Six-mic capture with ML voice boosting/noise suppression. 30-day free trial then $149.99 one-time or via Meta One; FSA/HSA eligible in US. US launch later in 2026; other countries to follow as regional device regulations are cleared. Supported frames not yet confirmed (minimum performance bar required).

articles.title: Apple Launches AirPods Pro Hearing Test Across Canada; Hearing Aid Feature Live in 5 Provinces
articles.summary: From Oct 26, 2026 Apple's Hearing Test is available nationwide in Canada on AirPods Pro 2 and 3 (iOS/iPadOS 27.2+). The clinical-grade Hearing Aid feature is enabled only in provinces permitting OTC hearing aid distribution: Alberta, British Columbia, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island and Saskatchewan. Apple is seeking approval province by province; Ontario (law change pending via Fall Economic Statement) and Quebec are not yet included. Arrives ~2 years after Health Canada authorization (Dec 2024).

articles.title: Shokz CEO Confirms Exploration of Hearing Devices, Smart Glasses and AI Assistant
articles.summary: Bone-conduction headphone maker Shokz is exploring hearing-related devices with activities underway in China and Australia, alongside smart glasses and an always-on AI assistant, per its CEO. The company is cautious about the 'hearing aid' label given regulatory implications; work is early-stage with no timeline.

articles.title: BMC Geriatrics: Older Adults in US, Canada, Australia and England Prefer Medical Settings Over Retail for Hearing Tests and Devices
articles.summary: Cross-sectional survey of ~8,150 adults 60+ (collected 2016-2018) found consistent preference for audiologist offices, doctors' offices and hospitals over retail, technology stores or mail order for hearing information, testing and devices — across degree of hearing loss, age, survey mode and country. Authors cite OTC devices at just 1-2% of US units (MarkeTrak 2025) and 85% of owners preferring in-person repurchase with a professional, cautioning OTC policy against assuming consumers prefer non-medical channels. Paper published Oct 13; international coverage Oct 24.

articles.title: Certus Hearing Launches Certus Max, a Bluetooth RIC Hearing Aid With a Touchscreen Case
articles.summary: Miami-based Certus Hearing launched Certus Max, a ~4 g rechargeable receiver-in-canal hearing aid for adults with perceived mild-to-moderate hearing loss — its first device streaming calls/music to both ears from iPhone and Android. Colour touchscreen charging case shows per-ear volume, mode and battery; 32-channel chip, four listening modes, app-based 5-minute hearing check, up to 15 h per charge, 90-day home trial, 2-year guarantee. Price and FDA/OTC registration details not stated in the release.

articles.title: Starkey and Minnesota Timberwolves Continue Partnership for 2026-27 NBA Season
articles.summary: Starkey announced continuation of its partnership with the Minnesota Timberwolves for the 2026-27 NBA season, focused on hearing health awareness and community impact beyond the game.

articles.title: GN Store Nord Rises 3.37% to DKK 112.10 as EU Decision on Amplifon/GN Hearing Sale Nears
articles.summary: GN Store Nord shares closed 23 Oct 2026 at DKK 112.10, up 3.37% from DKK 108.45 (+5.5% over five days). Investor commentary attributed the move to the approaching European Commission decision (provisional deadline Nov 6) on Amplifon's DKK 17bn acquisition of GN Hearing; GN reports Q3 in early November. articles.title: Medicare Hearing Aid Coverage Gets Another Push from a New Leader (Bill Terms: 80% Part B, One Aid per Ear Every 4 Years)
articles.summary: Hearing Tracker details the Medicare Dental, Vision, and Hearing Benefit Act (current version H.R. 2045, introduced Mar 2025, still at referral stage) that Rep. Mike Thompson will carry into the Congress beginning Jan 2027. It would repeal Medicare's statutory hearing aid exclusion, cover routine hearing exams and services under Part B, pay 80% of the approved amount, classify hearing aids as DME and generally limit coverage to one device per ear every 4 years (waivable). No change to current benefits.

articles.title: Macquarie MOSAIC Study: Gaze, Gestures and Pupil Signals Reveal When Conversation Becomes Difficult — Inputs for Next-Gen Hearing Devices
articles.summary: Macquarie University (led by MQ-Sonova research fellow Dr Kelly Miles) with Western Sydney University's MARCS Institute, Cochlear and Google Research Australia built a multisensor lab recording movement, eye behaviour, pupil dilation and speech (~1 TB) as background noise rose. Adaptations were graded and multimodal: non-native speakers looked at the mouth, native speakers at the eyes; gestures grew larger. Such signals could let hearing aids/CIs detect intended talker and listening effort, triggering processing only when needed to save battery. Work continues via the Australian Future Hearing Initiative.

articles.title: Starkey Named a 2026 Inc. Power Partner for Customer Success, Second Year Running
articles.summary: Starkey was named a 2026 Inc. Power Partner for excellence in customer success for the second consecutive year, citing support for hearing care professionals and its Omega AI+ platform.

articles.title: Ontario OTC Hearing Aids: Audiology Groups Warn of Misdiagnosis Risk; ADP Will Not Cover OTC Devices
articles.summary: Follow-up to Ontario's Oct 20 OTC announcement. Ontario Association of Professional Audiology (OAPAC) president Sanj Sukumaran warned consumers could miss conditions from wax to tumours; CASLPO called for safeguards, a clear legal framework and consumer protections. articles.title: Fortell Expands Prescription AI Hearing Aids to 30+ US States via New Clinics and 'Fortell Anywhere' Remote Fitting
articles.summary: Fortell is expanding access to its prescription AI hearing aids (custom AI chips separating speech from competing sounds on-device) across more than 30 states. articles.summary: Chicago-based ClearCast launched an FDA-registered AI 'listening aid' category that isolates and amplifies only human speech while filtering background noise, intended for situational use (dinners, TV, meetings) rather than all-day wear. articles.title: CHOICE Trial (JAMA Neurology): Hearing Aids Not Proven to Prevent Dementia, But 6x More Cognitive Improvement vs Control
articles.summary:
The CHOICE trial (Cognitive Health Improvement in Cognitive Elderly through Ear-care), published in JAMA Neurology on September 28, 2026, examined whether hearing aids reduce progression from mild cognitive impairment (MCI) to dementia in older adults with moderate-to-severe hearing loss.

TRIAL DESIGN: Randomized controlled trial, 2021–2026. 703 older adults (mean age 74.5, 64% male) with moderate-to-severe hearing loss and MCI (CDR global score 0.5) at three tertiary otology clinics and three community health stations in Shanghai. Hearing aid intervention: n=353; hearing care education control: n=350. 24-month follow-up.

PRIMARY ENDPOINT (null result): Conversion from MCI to dementia (CDR 0.5→1.0). Hearing aid group: 3.09% conversion; control group: 4.74% conversion. Risk difference: -2.07%; RR 0.59; p=0.23 — NOT statistically significant. Study was underpowered due to much lower-than-expected observed dementia conversion rates.

KEY SECONDARY FINDING: Cognitive improvement (CDR 0.5→0, return to normal cognition). Hearing aid group: 15.34% improved; control: 2.36% improved. Relative risk: 5.94 (p<0.001) — nearly 6x more likely to experience cognitive improvement with hearing aids.

LIMITATIONS: CDR eligibility criterion not prespecified (possible selection bias); reliance on subjective CDR scale; underpowered primary outcome; single-country (Chinese) population.

IMPLICATIONS: Primary 'dementia prevention' claim cannot be made from this trial. However, the striking 6x cognitive improvement finding is clinically meaningful and commercially valuable for hearing aid advocacy — a 'not yet disproven, and positive signal on reversal.' Lead researcher: Hao Wu MD PhD, Shanghai Jiao Tong University.

articles.title: Otarmeni (Regeneron) Gene Therapy Round-Up: Anthem Coverage Policy, First US Patients Treated, EU Review Ongoing — CI Competitive Context
articles.summary:
Round-up of developments since Regeneron's Otarmeni (lunsotogene parvec-cwha, formerly DB-OTO) received FDA accelerated approval on April 23, 2026 — the first gene therapy for genetic hearing loss. Key updates as of September 2026:

• ANTHEM COVERAGE POLICY (May 2026): Anthem (Elevance Health) issued a medical necessity policy covering Otarmeni for OTOF-related severe-to-profound SNHL. Criteria include: biallelic pathogenic OTOF variant confirmed; hearing loss ≥90 dB HL; preserved outer hair cell function (OAEs or cochlear microphonic present); no anatomic contraindications; no prior cochlear implant in the treated ear; no prior gene therapy.

• FIRST US PATIENTS: An Alabama child is among the first in the US to receive the treatment (Sep 13, 2026 report, AL.com). The administration pathway is a one-time surgical intracochlear infusion.

• EU REGULATORY STATUS: EMA accepted the MAA under Accelerated Assessment in May 2026. EU approval (if granted) would make it the first gene therapy for OTOF-related hearing loss in the EU. Review ongoing.

• CLINICAL EVIDENCE: CHORD trial (n=20): 80% of participants met the primary hearing sensitivity endpoint; 42% achieved normal hearing including ability to hear whispers with longer follow-up. Approved based on week-24 PTA improvement. Post-market data required on durability and speech/QoL outcomes (104-week follow-up required).

• PRICING: Regeneron is providing Otarmeni free of charge to US patients. Administration costs (surgery) are separate and covered through normal payer channels.

• CI COMPETITIVE CONTEXT (key): FDA label explicitly requires 'no prior cochlear implant in the same ear' — Otarmeni is a pre-CI intervention only. It does NOT compete with or replace established CI in already-implanted patients. Target population is ~20–50 OTOF-variant newborns per year in the US — an ultra-rare subset. In patients who fail or are ineligible for gene therapy, CI remains the standard of care. CI manufacturers should monitor whether Otarmeni reduces the eligible CI candidate pool in OTOF-positive patients (small but growing as genetic testing expands).

• RARE PEDIATRIC DISEASE VOUCHER: Regeneron received a Priority Review Voucher (PRV) which can be sold for hundreds of millions of dollars — partially offsets the free-to-patient pricing strategy.

articles.title: Meta Hearing Enhancement: Ray-Ban Models May NOT Be in Initial Rollout, Specific Compatible Frames Unconfirmed
articles.summary: HearingTracker (Sep 25, 2026) adds important nuance to Meta's Hearing Enhancement OTC hearing aid announcement from Meta Connect 2026. Key clarifications: (1) Meta has not published a list of compatible frames for Hearing Enhancement — buyers should confirm support before purchase. (2) According to Engadget, Ray-Ban models are NOT included in the initial rollout of the feature — directly complicating the earlier assumption that Ray-Ban Meta glasses would be the primary vehicle. (3) Ray-Ban Meta Audio (camera-free, $349, shipping Oct 13) was NOT confirmed to support Hearing Enhancement at launch. (4) The $149.99 add-on pricing and 'later in 2026 US launch' timeline are confirmed. (5) Meta One subscription details and professional fitting requirements not specified. The in-app hearing assessment personalizes amplification for adults with perceived mild-to-moderate hearing loss. This is a material update — the initial launch vehicle for the OTC hearing aid feature remains unspecified by Meta as of Sep 25.

articles.title: Meta Hearing Enhancement OTC Feature: $149.99 Add-On for AI Glasses, US Launch Later in 2026
articles.summary: Following Meta Connect 2026 (Sep 23), additional details on Meta's FDA-cleared Hearing Enhancement OTC hearing aid feature emerged. The feature is priced at $149.99 as an add-on to supported Meta AI glasses (Ray-Ban Meta compatible frames). US launch is confirmed for later in 2026, with no specific date given. Meta expects more than 100 AI glasses options across its portfolio by end of 2026. The in-app guided hearing test tunes amplification to the user's hearing profile; machine learning boosts voices and suppresses background noise. The $149.99 price point is significantly below Nuance Audio Plus ($829, launched Sep 22) and traditional OTC hearing aids, making Meta's entry the lowest-cost FDA-cleared OTC hearing solution on glasses to date. Intended for mild to moderate hearing loss.

articles.title: Meta Announces FDA-Cleared Hearing Enhancement Feature for Ray-Ban Meta Glasses at Connect 2026
articles.summary: At Meta Connect 2026 (September 23, 2026), Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg announced 'Hearing Enhancement' — an FDA-cleared over-the-counter hearing aid feature built into Meta Glasses (Ray-Ban Meta). The feature is designed for users with perceived mild to moderate hearing loss. It works by having users take a guided in-app hearing test, then tunes amplification to their individual hearing profile using machine learning to boost voices and suppress background noise. Meta described the pricing as 'a fraction of a hearing aid' — no specific price or availability date was confirmed. The feature arrives first on Meta Glasses. Meta's Ray-Ban Glasses previously received FDA 510(k) clearance (K254044, Jul 13, 2026) as air-conduction hearing aid software. This positions Meta directly alongside EssilorLuxottica's Nuance Audio Plus ($829, launched Sep 22) and Apple AirPods in the smart wearable OTC hearing market, adding major consumer-tech competitive pressure on traditional hearing aid brands.

articles.title: Signia MaX Launched at COSM Dallas — 'Most Important Launch to Date' per Signia
articles.summary: Signia launched the Signia MaX hearing aid at COSM Dallas on September 23, 2026, marked with a drone show and immersive hands-on demonstrations for hearing care professionals. Signia described it as 'the most important launch to date.' The event was aimed at hearing care professionals (HCPs) who will prescribe and fit the device. Limited additional technical details were available from the press release snippet. Signia is a brand of WS Audiology (WSA), the privately held hearing aid group (Widex/Signia). This follows earlier reports that the Signia MaX was targeting Korea digital medical device approval for November 2026.

articles.title: Sensorion H1 2026 Results: HearConnex Phase I/II Trial Authorized in France, Canada CTA Filed
articles.summary: Sensorion reported its 2026 half-year results on September 23, 2026 and provided a corporate update on its gene therapy hearing program. Key milestones: (1) Clinical Trial Applications filed in France and Canada for the Phase I/II HearConnex trial; (2) France's ANSM granted Fast Track procedure for the French CTA assessment; (3) In August 2026, ANSM authorized initiation of the HearConnex Phase I/II trial in France. HearConnex is a gene therapy approach targeting sensorineural hearing loss. While not a hearing aid, Sensorion's progress is relevant as a long-term therapeutic alternative to hearing aids and cochlear implants for patients with genetic hearing loss causes.

articles.title: Nuance Audio Plus Smart Glasses Launch with FDA Hearing Aid Clearance — $829, Available Now in US
articles.summary: EssilorLuxottica's Nuance Audio division launched the Nuance Audio Plus smart glasses on September 22, 2026 — cleared by the FDA as hearing aids for mild to moderate hearing loss. Priced at $829, the glasses include hearing aid hardware built into the frames' arms with improved sound boosting over Gen 1, better voice clarity, a 'Frontal' mode for face-to-face conversations, an 'All-Around' mode for ambient sound boosting, four-level background noise filtering, double-tap controls, and customizable speech-clarity settings via the Nuance smartphone app. Battery life is 10 hours. Available now in the US. EssilorLuxottica is Meta's partner for Ray-Ban smart glasses, and Nuance Audio occupies the prescription/OTC hearing glasses intersection alongside competitor categories including OTC hearing aids (Fortell, Samsung Galaxy Buds) and prescription brands (Phonak, Oticon). The FDA clearance as a hearing aid (not merely a hearing amplifier) is the key competitive differentiator vs Gen 1.

articles.title: Amplifon Shareholder Vote Advances GN Hearing Acquisition — DKK 17.0B Deal on Track for Year-End 2026 Close
articles.summary: Amplifon's board approved a capital increase reserved for GN Audio as the share-based portion of the DKK 17.0 billion (~$2.5B) acquisition consideration for GN Hearing. Amplifon confirmed the transaction remains on track to close by end of 2026, subject to applicable closing conditions. The deal was first announced in March 2026. When complete, Amplifon will combine its global retail audiological network with GN's ReSound and Jabra Enhance hearing aid brands, creating a vertically integrated global hearing health player and significantly reshaping the competitive landscape for prescription hearing aids.

articles.title: Fortell AI Hearing Aids Set New HearAdvisor Performance Records
articles.summary: Fortell announced on September 15, 2026 that its Fortell AI Hearing Aids achieved the highest overall and speech-in-noise scores ever recorded by independent laboratory HearAdvisor. The device earned an overall SoundScore of 6.0 (exceeding HearAdvisor's five-point scale), a speech-in-noise score of 6.4 (surpassing the previous record of 4.5), and a first-fit speech-in-quiet score of 5.4 (above the previous high of 4.7). Feedback management was rated perfect. These results from an independent lab position Fortell as a significant performance contender against established OTC and prescription hearing aid brands, including Phonak, Oticon, and Starkey — which have prominently marketed their AI and speech-in-noise capabilities.

articles.title: AI Hearing Aids Vie for Korea's 400 Billion Won Market
articles.summary: WS Audiology officially launched its next-generation hearing aid 'Signia MaX' in the global market on September 10, 2026. In South Korea, the product is currently undergoing the digital medical device approval process, with a target release date of November 2026. WS Audiology Korea's local unit was officially launched in Korea as part of the global expansion. The Korean hearing aid market is estimated at approximately 400 billion won (~$290M USD), with strong competition from AI-powered devices from multiple international players.

articles.title: India CGHS Revises Hearing Aid Reimbursement Ceiling to ₹30,000 per Ear
articles.summary: India's Ministry of Health & Family Welfare revised the reimbursement ceiling for hearing aids under the Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS) and CS(MA) Rules. The new ceiling is ₹30,000 per ear (inclusive of GST) for Standard Digital Programmable and Rechargeable Hearing Aids (Digital BTE and Digital ITC/CIC), with a mandatory 3-year comprehensive warranty. The revision supersedes the December 2020 guidelines and reflects India's growing recognition of hearing aid access as a healthcare priority. As one of the world's largest government employee health schemes, CGHS updates can signal direction for broader Indian reimbursement policy.

articles.title: ReSound Names Bob Eastman Vice President of Government Services (VA Focus)

Eastman joins GN with extensive leadership experience across the hearing healthcare industry. The appointment is strategically significant given GN's Q2 2026 results noted a major US key account drag — the VA channel is a critical revenue driver for ReSound in the US market, and GN is investing in dedicated leadership for this segment even as the broader GN Hearing business moves toward acquisition by Amplifon (expected to close by end of 2026).

articles.title: WSA Q3 FY2025/26: 3% Organic Growth, EBITDA Margin Up 2pts; Guidance Narrowed to 1-2%
articles.summary: WS Audiology (WSA — parent of Widex, Signia, and Rexton) reported Q3 FY2025/26 results on August 25, 2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026). Revenue reached €624 million (~US$729M), representing 3% organic growth — an acceleration from 1% in Q2. Reported revenue grew 1%, with €12M negative currency impact (weak USD/JPY vs EUR). EBITDA before special items rose 12% to €119M (margin: 19.1%, up 2 percentage points). Net profit increased to €24M from €20M. Consumer-facing channels (Online, Retail, Managed Care) grew 8% organically; Wholesale declined 2% due to softer US market and launch timing vs competitors. Geographically: Americas +4%, EMEA flat, APAC +3%. For the first 9 months of FY2025/26, revenue totalled €1.881B (+1% organic). WSA confirmed and narrowed full-year FY2025/26 guidance to 1-2% organic growth (from 0-4%). WSA cited recently launched Signia MaX and Widex Allure AI RIC (US launch: November 2026) as key wholesale growth catalysts for H2.

articles.title: Signia Introduces MaX: World's First Multi-DNN AI Hearing Aid Platform with Acoustic Intelligence
articles.summary: WSA-owned Signia launched Signia MaX (Multi-adaptive Xperience) on August 24, 2026 — described as the world's first hearing aid platform with four simultaneous task-specific Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) operating as one coordinated Acoustic Intelligence system. The four DNNs cover: 1) Speech Detection, 2) Own Voice Detection, 3) Scene Analysis, and 4) Noise Processing. The new MaX chip delivers 54x more processing power and 50% greater energy efficiency than previous generations. The first product, Pure C&G MaX (RIC, rechargeable), launched in the US, Germany and Nordics on August 24, with most remaining markets to follow later in 2026. Signia claims 97% of wearers performed better than key competitors in noisy group conversations. OneConnect Technology provides Bluetooth Classic, LE Audio, telecoil and Auracast in one device (full Auracast via firmware update by March 2027). Pricing not disclosed.

articles.title: Phonak Launches EON: Next-Generation AI Hearing Aid Platform with HYPERSONIC Chip
articles.summary: Sonova launched Phonak EON on August 24, 2026 — its next-generation hearing aid platform powered by the new HYPERSONIC chip. EON combines Spheric Speech Clarity 3.0, AutoSense OS AI 8.0, and Made-For-All connectivity (including Auracast). The device is 25% smaller and 20% lighter than the previous Sphere generation, with up to 38 hours of battery life. The portfolio includes Audéo EON Sphere (mild to profound), Audéo EON R, and CROS EON R for unilateral hearing loss. US launch on August 24; Germany, France, UK, Australia and other markets to follow in September 2026. Reuters noted the launch is Sonova's 'latest effort to strengthen its position in a market that relies on rapid technology upgrades to shorten replacement cycles and attract first-time users.'

FX reduced reported growth by 3pp. DKK 58M one-off carve-out costs in Q2; DKK 100–150M US tariff refunds expected H2 2026. Amplifon deal (DKK 17.0B total: DKK 12.6B cash + 56M Amplifon shares) remains on track to close year-end 2026. GN launched three products in three weeks: ReSound Sensia (Aug 20 in US/Germany/Austria), Beltone Illuminate, Jabra Enhance Select M Series. articles.title: NDIS Reform Bill Passed: AudA and AHPA Warn of Impact on Australians with Hearing Loss
articles.summary: On August 19, 2026, the Australian Senate passed the National Disability Insurance Scheme Amendment (Securing the NDIS for Future Generations) Bill 2026. Audiology Australia (AudA) and Allied Health Professions Australia (AHPA) responded on August 21 expressing serious concern. AudA warned that approximately 160,000 NDIS participants could lose access from January 2028, when new eligibility criteria take effect. For people with hearing loss specifically, AudA noted they already navigate multiple funding systems (NDIS, Hearing Services Program, industrial schemes, private/public health) and that the reform creates significant uncertainty. Key changes: new standardised functional capacity assessments from Jan 2028; budget resets for social participation supports from Oct 2026 (−50%) and capacity-building daily activities (−10%); tighter eligibility requiring permanent impairment. AudA had submitted to the Senate Committee in May 2026 calling for clearer hearing-specific protections. No changes to NDIS access until January 1, 2028.

articles.title: ReSound Sensia Full Review: Available August 20 in US — AI Hearing Aid Launches Commercially

Battery life rated at 24 hours typical, 30 hours maximum. Expected retail price range $4,500–$6,000 (not yet formally confirmed by GN Hearing). FalCom) and Gaming +5%. Gross margin improved to 52.1% (+1.7pp). Adjusted EBITA margin for continuing ops was 5.1% (vs 7.1% in Q2 2025), with FCF of −DKK 616M (temporary increase from insourcing). Hearing (discontinued, pending Amplifon sale) posted DKK 1,772M revenue with −2% organic growth. Full-year guidance upgraded: EBITA margin raised to 9–10% (from 8–9%), organic growth narrowed to 0–3% (from 0–6%). The Amplifon/GN Hearing transaction remains on track to close by end-2026. Conference call held August 20 at 11am CEST. GN.CO stock rose ~3.4% pre-market on the guidance upgrade.

articles.title: Unitron Moxi S-RX: Sonova Brings DEEPSONIC AI Chip to Unitron Brand for First Time
articles.summary: Unitron (a Sonova brand) launched the Moxi S-RX rechargeable RIC hearing aid in Australia on July 15, 2026, featuring the DEEPSONIC chip — the same dedicated deep neural network chip used in Phonak's premium Audéo Infinio Ultra Sphere. A national Australian roadshow ran July 14–28. Hearing Practitioner Australia published a detailed launch article on August 12 and a clinical deep-dive on August 17–18. Key specs: dual-chip architecture — ERA chip (main processing, Integra OS environment classification) + DEEPSONIC chip (dedicated DNN, solely focused on real-time speech-from-noise separation via SoundSonic360); up to 10 dB SNR improvement; 3× SNR benefit vs competitors; 2× more likely to understand speech in complex environments; 37% reduction in listening effort. Available in tiers 9 and 7 only. New EasyGuard domes for wax protection. Connectivity: Made For All universal Bluetooth (iPhone and Android). Programs: SpeechSonic360, NoiseSonic360, HyperFocus. UK pricing approximately £1,695–£1,895 per aid. Commercial significance: Sonova is extending its DEEPSONIC AI chip ecosystem from premium Phonak to the mid-market Unitron brand, broadening AI hearing aid reach and compressing the technology tier gap.

articles.title: Cochlear FY26 Full Year Results: Revenue AUD 2.3B, Net Profit AUD 322M, Stock Surges 7%

Underlying net profit was AUD 322 million, at the upper end of revised guidance (AUD 290-330M). Gross margin declined to 71%, reflecting FX headwinds, product mix, and China pricing pressure. Free cash flow more than doubled vs prior year. The Nexa cochlear implant platform now accounts for more than 95% of implant sales in developed markets. FY2027 guidance: low-single-digit revenue growth, underlying net profit AUD 330-350M. Cochlear shares rose 7.19% to A$140.69 (from A$131.25).
